description: Defines the template class ScreenConnectorInputMultiplexer for multiplexing screen connector frames, including queue registration, push, and pop operations, with logic to select between Android and Conf UI frames based on host mode.

classes.name: ScreenConnectorInputMultiplexer
classes.description: A template class that manages multiplexing of processed frames from screen connector, switching between Android and Conf UI frames based on host mode.

methods.name: PushToAndroidQueue
methods.description: Pushes a processed frame to the Android queue.

methods.name: PushToConfUiQueue
methods.description: Pushes a processed frame to the Conf UI queue.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Retrieves the next processed frame, selecting the appropriate queue based on host mode and queue state.
